card.fires_on: The space, "and", or first digit just before a time number such as 60 or 30 in lists of blood-sampling minutes, mostly cosyntropin and growth hormone tests.

modes.label: Before the next sampling time
modes.description: A space or "and" right before the next minute value in a series of blood draw times.
